work.abstract_text: For Sun's Conjecture 1 in OEIS A346934, COMMENTS, revision 29 (November 5, 2025), unchanged in revision 38 (October 26, 2026), we give an alternative proof of the sign consequence of Kunisky-Spielman-Yu's skew rank-two identity (arXiv:2608.28520v1, August 28, 2026, Section 5, pages 24-25) and prove the composite-modulus assertion using Marcus's expansion (arXiv:2108.02528v1, August 5, 2021, Lemma 4). The sign identity gives an equality criterion for arbitrary real inputs. For integer additive matrices of order q-1, divisibility of every permanent by q holds exactly when q is composite and q is not 4. Farhi's binomial-coefficient identity gives their exact common divisor. We also prove the immediate sum- and power-matrix consequences and identify earlier proofs of the related reciprocal assertions.

work.title: Alternative proofs for Sun's difference-permanent conjectures and Kunisky-Spielman-Yu's sign identity
